## Purpose

Software control category, software safety criticality and level-of-rigor assignments for
walker motion control, protective stop, pilot HMI, dock interlocks and PX4. The safety-significant
software function records live in [`safety/software/`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/tree/main/safety/software) (SSF-001 ...). MIL-STD-882E
criticality is kept distinct from any DO-178C assurance level.

## SysML model

SysML v2 textual view: [`SoftwareSafety.sysml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/safety/mil-std-882e/software-safety/SoftwareSafety.sysml), generated from the catalog. It imports the project model in [`models/sysml/model`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/tree/main/models/sysml/model): `SusanooArchitecture` (elements and usage paths) and `SusanooLibrary` (882E vocabulary). The figures are drawn from the same data; the `.sysml` file is the model of record.

![Figure 4 · SysML block definition — software criticality assignment](assets/safety/mil-std-882e/software-safety/figures/fig-4-sysml-block-definition.svg)

<details><summary>SysML v2 source</summary>

```sysml
// SoftwareSafety — generated by tools/gen_safety_docs.py from safety/mil-std-882e/catalog.yaml.
// Do not edit by hand: change the catalog and regenerate.
// Status: planning view only; not evidence of completed analysis or verification.

package SoftwareSafety {
    private import ScalarValues::*;
    private import SusanooLibrary::*;
    private import SusanooArchitecture::*;
    item def SoftwareFunctionAssessment {
        attribute functionId : String;
        attribute controlCategory : SoftwareControlCategory;
        attribute severity : SeverityCategory;
        attribute levelOfRigor : String;
        attribute independentMitigation : Boolean;
    }
}
```

</details>
